value.title: A contest of champions
value.text: Dalinar and Odium agree on a contest, with ten days for both sides to prepare.

value.title: Kaladin and Szeth in Shinovar
value.text: They cross the storms to Szeth’s homeland and find the Herald Ishar behind its silence.

value.title: Fronts falling
value.text: Odium’s side gains ground at Thaylenah, Azimir and the Shattered Plains.

value.title: Retribution
value.text: Dalinar renounces Honor’s power. Odium absorbs it, kills the Stormfather and becomes Retribution.

value.title: Stormfall
value.text: Retribution’s ascension ends the old storms and leaves Roshar isolated in slowed time. Provisional account based on the Coppermind wiki; not independently checked against the book.

value.title: Hoid seeks help
value.text: In the epilogue Hoid travels to Scadrial to look for allies against Retribution.

value.name: Narak (Stormseat)
value.desc: The old Natanatan capital at the centre of the Plains, the listeners’ stronghold, with an Oathgate on a plateau to its south-west.

value.name: The Shattered Plains
value.desc: Plateaus split by deep chasms, where the Alethi warcamps hunt chasmfiends for gemhearts. The fragments of a fourth moon that fell long ago lie beneath. Kaladin runs bridges here as a slave.

value.name: Cultivation’s Perpendicularity
value.desc: A crater lake in the Horneater Peaks: Roshar’s stable doorway into Shadesmar and the usual way worldhoppers arrive. It vanished when Cultivation left in Wind and Truth.

value.name: Kharbranth
value.desc: A city-state built up a mountainside in a wedge harbour on the Tarat Sea, with the Palanaeum library dug beneath it. Shallan finds Jasnah here; its king is Taravangian.

value.status: Retribution’s world · cut off in slowed time
value.blurb: Dalinar challenged Odium to a contest of champions and, holding Honor’s power at the end, renounced it. Odium took Honor’s power into his own and became Retribution, killed the Stormfather, drew all Stormlight from the world and turned the highstorm into a planet-wide Everstorm. Time on Roshar has slowed, so about a decade there passes for decades elsewhere. Azir, Urithiru and the Shattered Plains resist his rule. Provisional account based on the Coppermind wiki; not independently checked against the book.

value.name: Kelsier
value.desc: Leader of the crew that brings down the Lord Ruler.
more: His story continues after death in Secret History.
Works with the Ghostbloods far from Scadrial.

value.name: Kaladin Stormblessed
value.desc: A soldier made slave who becomes the first of the new Knights Radiant.

value.name: Shallan Davar
value.desc: An artist and scholar hiding a past she won’t remember.

value.name: Dalinar Kholin
value.desc: A warlord trying to become a better man.
more: Becomes the Bondsmith.
Dies after renouncing Honor’s power.

value.title: Into the Spiritual Realm
value.text: Dalinar opens a perpendicularity in the tower and goes with Navani into the Spiritual Realm to learn the truth about the past.

value.title: Taln’s Honorblade
value.text: At Stoneward Szeth kills a corrupted stone shaman and takes back the first of the stolen Honorblades.

value.title: Kaladin and Nale
value.text: Kaladin duels the Herald Nale, who yields his Honorblade and reveals what Ishar has done to Shinovar.

value.title: The Fifth Ideal
value.text: Ishar raises corrupted Honorbearers against them. Kaladin speaks the Fifth Ideal and frees Ishar, and Szeth fights with Nightblood.

value.title: The defence of Azimir
value.text: Adolin helps the Azish defend the Oathgate under the Grand Market dome against Odium’s armies and a thunderclast, at terrible cost to himself.

value.title: Bridge Four on Narak
value.text: Sigzil and Bridge Four hold four fortresses on Narak. They fall one by one, and Venli’s chasmfiends storm Narak Prime.

value.title: Fen’s choice
value.text: Odium out-argues Jasnah over the contest’s terms, and Queen Fen signs Thaylenah over to him without a battle.

value.title: Cusicesh speaks
value.text: For the first time, the great spirit of Kasitor speaks to the Iriali and opens a gateway for them to leave Roshar.

value.name: Narak (Stormseat)
value.desc: The old Natanatan capital at the centre of the Plains, the listeners’ stronghold, with an Oathgate on a plateau to its south-west.

landmarks.name: The listener city
landmarks.desc: Ruined Natanatan buildings at the heart of the Plains where the listeners make their stronghold. Here Eshonai’s people sing in the new forms that call the Everstorm.

landmarks.name: The Oathgate plateau
landmarks.desc: A round plateau south-west of Narak, its gate hidden under centuries of crem. Shallan finds the mechanism and carries the trapped armies away to Urithiru.

landmarks.name: Narak One
landmarks.desc: One of four fortresses Sigzil and Bridge Four build on Narak to hold the Plains through the ten days of the contest. It is the first to fall.

landmarks.name: Narak Two
landmarks.desc: The fortress Sigzil falls back to after Narak One is lost, and holds while Narak Three falls.

landmarks.name: Narak Three
landmarks.desc: The third fortress, lost on the seventh day.

landmarks.name: Narak Prime
landmarks.desc: The central stronghold and the last line on the Plains, stormed by Venli’s chasmfiends at the end of the defence.

value.name: The Shattered Plains
value.desc: Plateaus split by deep chasms, where the Alethi warcamps hunt chasmfiends for gemhearts. The fragments of a fourth moon that fell long ago lie beneath. Kaladin runs bridges here as a slave.

landmarks.name: The contested plateaus
landmarks.desc: Chasmfiends climb up onto the plateaus to pupate, and the highprinces race each other across the chasms to cut out the gemhearts. Bridge crews run ahead under listener arrows, carrying the bridges.

landmarks.name: The chasms
landmarks.desc: Deep cracks between the plateaus, flooded by every highstorm. Bridge Four is sent down to scavenge from the dead, and Kaladin secretly trains his men with spears here.

landmarks.name: The Honor Chasm
landmarks.desc: A chasm a short walk from Sadeas’s warcamp, the one place bridgemen may go unwatched, and where despairing bridgemen jump. Kaladin comes here meaning to end it, and Syl talks him into trying once more.

landmarks.name: The eastern pillars
landmarks.desc: Toward the east the chasms widen and the plateaus break into impassable pillars, the way the listeners came and went.

value.name: Cultivation’s Perpendicularity
value.desc: A crater lake in the Horneater Peaks: Roshar’s stable doorway into Shadesmar and the usual way worldhoppers arrive. It vanished when Cultivation left in Wind and Truth.

landmarks.name: Cultivation’s Perpendicularity
landmarks.desc: A crater lake that opens into Shadesmar, the usual way worldhoppers come to Roshar.

value.name: Kharbranth
value.desc: A city-state built up a mountainside in a wedge harbour on the Tarat Sea, with the Palanaeum library dug beneath it. Shallan finds Jasnah here; its king is Taravangian.

landmarks.name: The Conclave
landmarks.desc: The king’s palace, dug into the mountain at the top of the city. Here Taravangian reveals to Szeth that he holds his oathstone and sends him after Dalinar.

landmarks.name: The Palanaeum
landmarks.desc: The greatest library on Roshar, beneath the Conclave. Shallan finds Jasnah studying here and talks her way into becoming her ward.

landmarks.name: The Ralinsa
landmarks.desc: The switchback road climbing from the harbour to the Conclave.

landmarks.name: The harbour
landmarks.desc: A natural wedge harbour on the Tarat Sea. Shallan arrives here on the Wind’s Pleasure, and leaves on it with Jasnah.

landmarks.name: The theatre-district alley
landmarks.desc: Jasnah walks into a dark alley knowing she will be attacked, and Soulcasts the four thugs who follow her while Shallan watches.

landmarks.name: The hospitals
landmarks.desc: Kharbranth’s hospitals are famous across Roshar, and its surgeons go wherever there is war.

landmarks.name: The bells
landmarks.desc: The City of Bells: chimes all over the city ring the hours and warn of highstorms.
